decoder: labvision.markers: soft ArUco posterior over the catalogue, every copy of the ring fused across cameras (TEMPER=0.5); accept >= 0.999, rescan >= 0.9, else reject
probability: posterior that sample_id is the bottle at position, under labvision.markers' noise model. NOT calibrated yet: see computer-vision/docs/READ_CONFIDENCE.md and metrics.by_decision
position: bottle axis at label height: depth under the ring quads, pushed back by the bottle radius; surface_point is the raw point
position_spread_m: largest distance of one view's point from surface_point
gt_position: the ground-truth label centre (method gt), for scoring
